entities.summary: Francis Thomas was an American politician who served as the 26th governor of Maryland from 1842 to 1845. He also served as a United States representative from Maryland, representing at separate times the fourth, fifth, sixth, and seventh districts. He also served as United States minister to Peru from 1872 to 1875, and speaker of the Maryland House of Delegates in 1829.
